tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read-only. Use first when the agent needs Dreamlit product guidance, prompting guidance, approved workspace context, project setup, schema hints, workflow state, or relevant app URLs. Returns a compact context pack with concepts, recommended tool flow, actor/workspace/project data, optional authorin

tools.name: create_or_update_workflow
tools.description: Creates a new Dreamlit workflow draft or updates an existing draft from an outcome-oriented natural-language prompt. Use after get_status; use get_workflow_and_preview_url first when editing an existing workflow, then describe the steps to change by what they do, not by step id. Each call continues

tools.name: edit_workflow_steps
tools.description: Applies up to 5 exact edits to existing steps in a workflow draft, instantly and without AI: email subject, preview text, HTML, sender, reply-to, and recipient; Slack message; query SQL; wait rule; and step description. Use when you know the exact new value; call get_workflow_and_preview_url first f

tools.name: rename_workflow
tools.description: Use when the user asks to rename an existing Dreamlit workflow. Side effect: changes only the workflow name; the draft, published version, and live triggers are unchanged. Returns the updated name and app URLs. Do not use to edit workflow content or to name a new workflow; pass name to create_or_upd

tools.name: move_workflow_to_folder
tools.description: Use when the user asks to put a workflow or broadcast in a folder, move it to another folder, or take it out of a folder. Folders are per list: the Published and Drafts lists on the Workflows page and the Sent and Drafts lists on the Broadcasts page each have their own folders, and this moves the wo

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Read-only. Use when the target project is unknown or the user names a project instead of providing an id. Returns accessible Dreamlit projects in the approved workspace with project and workflow-list URLs. Do not use to inspect workflow structure or author changes.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: Read-only. Use to find workflows in a project by name, description, or trigger type before inspection or editing. Trigger filters include database, auth email, repeating, broadcast, and no-trigger workflows. Returns paginated workflow summaries, published/sandbox state, liveStatus, trigger type, fol

tools.name: list_brand_styles
tools.description: Read-only. Use when the user wants to inspect saved project brand styles for generated email drafts. Returns paginated project brand style summaries, ids, default status, style metadata, and app URLs. Do not use to create, update, delete, or expose raw style provenance.

tools.name: get_workflow_and_preview_url
tools.description: Read-only. Use before editing, verifying, or preparing publish for an existing workflow. Returns normalized draft and published workflow structure, liveStatus, the Dreamlit preview/builder URL, and status URLs. Broadcasts also include a broadcast object with state (draft, scheduled, sending, sent, c

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Read-only. Use to query Dreamlit analytics for overview metrics, notification rows, recipient engagement, or workflow run rows with filters, sorting, and cursor pagination. Returns bounded structured analytics data, effective query metadata, pagination details when rows are included, and relevant ap

tools.name: send_workflow_test
tools.description: Side effect when confirmSend is true: sends one current draft email or Slack message for review, but does not publish, schedule, or edit the workflow. Use after authoring or inspection when the user wants to verify an important message before publishing. Returns sent-test details, app URLs, a confir

tools.name: prepare_publish
tools.description: Read-only validation step before publishing. Use after the user asks to publish and after inspecting the workflow if needed. Returns validation status, publish mode, preview URL, and a confirmation payload with version/timestamp safety checks for confirm_publish. Does not publish or schedule anythin

tools.name: confirm_publish
tools.description: Use only after explicit user confirmation and a prior prepare_publish result to publish or schedule a Dreamlit workflow. Side effect: installs live database/repeating/auth triggers, schedules or sends broadcasts, and may enable notification delivery; sandbox mode can hold notifications for inspectio

tools.name: unpublish_workflow
tools.description: Use after explicit user intent to unpublish a Dreamlit workflow. Side effect: disables live triggers or schedules so no new runs start. Runs already in progress keep sending unless inProgressRuns is "stop". If the workflow has in-progress runs and inProgressRuns is omitted, returns clarification_req

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_status, move_workflow_to_folder, list_projects, list_workflows, list_brand_styles, get_workflow_and_preview_url, get_analytics, prepare_publish · Private data: get_status, create_or_update_workflow, list_workflows, get_analytics, confirm_publish · Public sink: get_status, create_or_update_workflow, edit_workflow_steps, move_workflow_to_folder, list_workflows, list_brand_styles, get_workflow_and_preview_url, send_workflow_test, prepare_publish, confirm_publish, unpublish_workflow · Destructive: get_status, create_or_update_workflow, edit_workflow_steps, move_workflow_to_folder, list_brand_styles, get_workflow_and_preview_url, get_analytics, send_workflow_test, unpublish_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_status, move_workflow_to_folder, list_projects, list_workflows, list_brand_styles, get_workflow_and_preview_url, get_analytics, prepare_publish · Private data: get_status, create_or_update_workflow, list_workflows, get_analytics, confirm_publish · Public sink: get_status, create_or_update_workflow, edit_workflow_steps, move_workflow_to_folder, list_workflows, list_brand_styles, get_workflow_and_preview_url, send_workflow_test, prepare_publish, confirm_publish, unpublish_workflow · Destructive: get_status, create_or_update_workflow, edit_workflow_steps, move_workflow_to_folder, list_brand_styles, get_workflow_and_preview_url, get_analytics, send_workflow_test, unpublish_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
